prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: second vehicle type for the Pelican 429 game, a SIMPLE OPEN-AIR MAGLEV RAIL TRAIN. The reference is the EXISTING ENCLOSED first type. Use its pearl-white and satin stainless materials, subtle cyan magnetic lights, guideway design and polished rounded 3D style. Design a clearly DIFFERENT lightweight open vehicle, not another enclosed train.
Subject: two short linked open passenger carts, each with two rows of two seats (four seats per cart), on a slim white floating chassis. Exposed silver handrails, a low white nose below knee height, comfortable pale gray bucket seats, simple individual lap bars, visible foot wells. All seating is completely OUTSIDE and visible, open to the sky and the sides. NO roof, NO canopy, NO glass windshield, NO cabin, NO tall sidewalls. Only low side rails. A small neat coupler links the carts. White pearl upper panels, satin stainless lower levitation units, restrained cyan marker light strips. Clean and very simple silhouette, no clutter, no ornamental machinery. Floating a small visible distance above the same single elevated guideway as the reference. No tires or wheels.
Show TWO small stylized game passengers seated in the front row of the leading cart, one in muted coral casual clothes and one in pale gray, with hands and feet inside, fastened lap bars. Other six seats empty. Passengers illustrate clearly that people ride outside, not inside a cabin. Maintain the same seating and passenger arrangement in all views. Friendly slightly chibi 3D game proportions, soft rounded forms, optimistic future transit, not photorealistic adults.
Composition: landscape 3:2 concept sheet of THREE consistent views of THIS ONE NEW OPEN TRAIN. Top half a large strict LEFT SIDE orthographic elevation with leading nose pointing left, both complete short carts visible. Bottom left true FRONT view showing the two seated passengers and exposed seats, no glass. Bottom right FRONT-LEFT 45 degree view showing both complete carts and all rows. All train parts comfortably inside the image with margins; guideway short segments beneath each view. Neutral light gray studio background and soft diffuse shadows matching reference. Small labels SIDE, FRONT, 45°. No other text. Preserve exact number of carts, seats, passengers and same body shape in every view. Make it clearly simple, light, open, technologically advanced, a little playful, suitable for the user's side-scrolling game. Do not reproduce the enclosed reference train.
